Easy Peasy. Lemon Squeezy

Pink Noise for the Win!!!. I had no idea what Pink Noise was until I discovered this app! It really helps me fall asleep and stay asleep throughout the night. 

Additionally, it also improves my focus while I'm working at my desk. I find that it allows me to concentrate better and minimizes distractions, keeping me from getting sidetracked by thoughts or tasks unrelated to my work.
Sound Sleep. It really helps me sleep through out the night.
Amazing!. I use this app almost every night. I live in an apartment complex on the first floor and the noise can be disruptive. This app helps me sleep.
Had this for years now. It’s great!!!
Well Balanced Tone. Most sleep sound apps sound terrible in my opinion. Normally they are too high frequency heavy. Not Rx Noise. Super well balanced sound!
Sweet simple and just what you needzzzzzzzz. Get it!
Oh wow! Where’s the Tinnitus?!?!. Slept great and I didn’t “hear “ my tinnitus one snooze, uh one time 😴💤🤿😴💤🤿

Great app I love how simple it is. Does one thing. Plays noise. Volume slider and play button. Only thing they could improve is make the background a solid color instead of that ugly galaxy thing they have going. But who cares you only actually look at it for 2 seconds to press play because it’s so simple. 10/10

Simple, easy, free. I normally sleep with earplugs, but I forgot them on this trip. I downloaded this app to my iPad and had it play white all night to help drown out external sounds in my hotel room. 

Upside: simple (play, pause, volume) and free.
 
Downside: would be nice to have an option to change the pitch of the sound. Though it did the job, I’d have preferred it a bit lower. Not a big enough issue to cost a star, though.

Thank you. Being in the hospital it’s hard for me to calm my mind. Alarms going off, voices in the hall, Hearing meds sent up the tube in the middle of the night, and that’s just the tip of the iceberg. I wasn’t getting any sleep til about 2am. Then I found this app. I thought maybe it was to good to be true but I tried it and I’m glad I did. It calms me within a half hour and soon after I drift off til morning. I let it play all night. Thank you for making this awesome and magical app. So far my favorite to calm down by.
Good app. Love the sound

Why is the volume so low?. This app is better than any other pink noise app I have tried. However, the volume is so low! Even at max level within the app, and with my phone volume set to max, the pink noise sound is so faint through my ear buds. Please give an option to make this louder!

Great app!. “Pink noise” has been shown to help with deeper, more satisfying sleep. I had problems vs falling asleep and then would wake up several times a night. Usually I could go back to sleep, but occasionally, I couldn’t. 
Listening to pink noise via my I-Phone not only helps me fall asleep fast but to stay asleep. In the morning, I feel rested, which wasn’t the case before.
Simple and effective. Just what you need, no more, no less.
Calming. Wonderful app! Thank you for sharing 🙏
Awesome. The sound is perfect and wisks me peacefully into la la land
Like a sleeping pill. Turning on the pink noise has helped me fall asleep faster and stay asleep. If I do wake up during the night, I am able to fall back to sleep easily.
Worthless. Buggy. Freezes up constantly
Sleep sound. Great sound for sleep
Best Sleep. Download and get a good night sleep. Didn’t think it would help at first but had it on all night and slept 6 hours instead of usual 4
Exactly what I needed. I work in an environment with a lot of chatter, making it difficult to focus. The combination of this app and noise-canceling earbuds has been a game changer.
Jet noise. I can’t fly an hour without falling asleep!! This app sounds like the inside of a jet while flying pits me right to sleep
My favorite noise generator. Love Rx Noise. The pink noise it generates is very soft. No hard edgy characteristics. Perfect for travel.

Best sleeping sounds. I had tried a couple different apps but they were not soothing. More musical which was ok until high squeaky sounds. Ruined the whole mood. This app is just a consistent rain sound that really works
One sound. Unless you plan to pay for a subscription, you’ll get one…one sound.

Wonderful. So relaxing after just 1 minute of “noise”.
I’ve become conditioned. It’s such a beautiful
Sound.

Gets the job done. One sound, one button, no confusion. I love how you can control the sound from within the app and also have sound from other apps play simultaneously (like music or audiobook). White noise is too harsh and hissy but this pink noise is just right!!
Wonderful. Go to sleep and stay asleep
Only one sound available. Need I say more…
Nothing happened. Boring
Excellent tool!. Thank you very much!
Love it. I use this app every night to sleep
Works for Me!. Simple and effective.
Super simple, super great. This app is just some nice white noise. On and off - nothing fancy. I choose this app when I know I want white noise and that’s it.

Works like a dream (pun intended)!. This sound generator provided an amazing “cure” for chronic insomnia immediately. I had been using an app with “white noise” plus optional additional sounds which was in a much higher pitch. This one is the real deal so far. The sound is lower frequency without harsh hissing sounds.
Like. Helps me stay asleep
Great sleep aid. Puts me right to sleep!

Love this app but it’s a battery hog. This works perfectly to fall asleep quickly and stay deep asleep. BUT I have to have a full charge or make sure phone is plugged in or my phone will completely die within 6 hours. Please fix that because I love the simplicity of this app!
Pink noise. This app that has pink noise has been a life saver! I moved into a condo with noisy neighbors upstairs. If it weren’t for the pink noise app, I wouldn’t be getting much sleep!
Good. Very good, mind clear
Wow!. Exactly what I was looking for, thanks!!!!
Great sleeping sounds. Great options for soothing sleeping/calming sounds!

Love this App. I sleep so much better with this sound playing in the back ground. It has improved my sleep habits and ability to get to sleep a lot faster. Wish they offered others sounds to try as well.
Simple, effective. Does exactly what I wanted it to do.
Great. This helps my sleep Good job
Best sleep. I always sleep with a fan on for the noise but this pink noise is so much better. Plus it doesn’t stop my alarm from going off in the morning like some other noise apps have. ♥️♥️♥️
Best free pink noise app!. Great app!

So 🤩 Awesome. I tried an app that uses different color noises on the advice of my best friend. On a whim I tried pink noise and this is the first one I got. I slept SO WELL the very first night. Then the second, and every other night since. I love it.
Sound. Good
RX noise. Good

Love this app. I love this app. The sound drowns out my spouse’s snoring and all of the other noises that used to keep me up at night. Now I sleep much better thanks to this app. But the best thing about it is the support folks. There was a glitch a few days ago that caused the app to crash after a few seconds of play. I contacted support and they fixed the problem ASAP and kept me apprised of the status of the fix all along the way. The app is back to functioning perfectly and I am back to sleeping soundly.
Good, but…. Wish there was a timer feature.
Best sound for sleep ever!. And I have tried them all. I love this one. It’s just right!

Relaxing 😊. I sleep so much better. Glad I found it 
Pat😘👍😘

Really great. The pink noise is very relaxing especially when used with noise canceling headphones
Great pink noise. Great for sleep while traveling. No auditory ads interrupting your sleep. The ads are visual as you start the pink noise.
Yes it’s really free!. Love, love, love this. Thank you for delivering as promised.
Not enough volume. Too low of volume…easy fix!

reviews.text: Simple. Calming. Free.. I like the ease of use-just hit play and go! I haven’t poked around but don’t see other color frequencies which would be nice, but I searched for pink noise and got it. I didn’t have to purchase anything to listen for longer than a few minutes. Thanks!
Helped with setting up my EQ. This was a big help in setting up my EQ on my ham radio. Trying for that articulate sound. About 2500 hz.
perfect. i’m a very light sleeper and i can’t sleep without playing this at night it blocks out every noise. also it’s white noise, not pink noise but still perfect for sleep.

I keep remembering my dreams. It’s just honestly awesome are you still not have dreams and I’ve been actually having frequent dreams on this is just amazing this game I mean a game like app but anyways it’s just like purchase it now please
excellent sound. Sleeping much better!
Love it. I slept so good! I hate hi frequency noises and this is amazing!

Simple but effective. I don’t need all the complicated annoying apps so this one is PERFECT for when I’m traveling and don’t have access to my sound machine. I can’t sleep when it’s quiet and im so glad I found this app !

Timer Function. Am I missing the timer function another reviewer mentioned last year?? Developer response was “update was coming.” A year later and I don’t see a timer setting, just play and stop. This app would be better with a timer to auto turn off at various times (like my TV timer) and a less bright annoying ad flashing at the bottom of the screen advertising a Casino game that adds bright blue light to a darkened room. Kind of Defeats purpose of a noise sleep aid.
Helps for sleep. Never knew there are different color white noise
Drowns out partner’s snoring!. RX Noise is the perfect white noise app, used with wireless ear buds. Simple, free, easy!
Phone battery drain. This app has started completely draining my phone battery at night which wasn’t the case before
Much improved deep sleep. Love this app!!

Super easy to use. I travel every now and again and have tried different apps. A lot of them say they are free but once you have installed it etc., it wants you to pay. So many of them I have gone through this ritual! It was a breath of fresh air to install this app and be able to use it within 30 sec. Sound is great and soothing! Love this app!!!
Love. Love this app to sooth me to sleep

Amazing app. I love this App so much, it helps me sleep and it helps me wake up in the morning so I can turn it back off. The sound is just like a fan and it is amazing for people who are having hard time. You can tell me if I’m wrong, but I think app is super amazing for little kids that are having the hard time to sleep.
Rx noise. Helps me sleep better than I ever have!
Kim Kim. Great

It works. We play this through a Bose speaker and have found it helps us sleep. My wife normally finds it hard to fall back asleep when she wakes up in the night to use the bathroom. With this app playing she finds it much easier to fall back asleep.
Slept great. It’s amazing I slept so peacefully and woke up feeling rested.

Superb. Amazing

Simplicity!. I can’t believe how well this app works. Obviously it depends on your personal situation but for me it’s been amazing. For an app that’s so simple it’s almost not even an app it does the job better than I could have imagined.
The key to my sleep. I have been using this app for a couple years now and I love it. It’s simple and does the job with no fuss. Can’t recommend it enough. Thank you!
